key.name: history-size
key.description: Pinned items are never evicted. The most recent unpinned items are kept up to this limit.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When enabled, new copies are not recorded.

key.name: paste-on-selection
key.description: Paste the entry into the focused app immediately after picking it.

key.name: ignore-password-mimes
key.description: Skip clipboard content marked sensitive by password managers.

key.name: strip-text
key.description: Remove leading/trailing whitespace from copied text.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show a clipboard button in the top bar that toggles the panel.

key.name: follow-caret
key.description: Place the panel next to the field you are typing in (falls back to the mouse pointer, then screen center).
